start: mags: Captain! Mind the pot, it spits.

then: mags[happy]: Stew. It's always stew. Today it's got fish in, and some of the fish is new.
captain[annoyed]: And the rest of the fish?

mags.rats: mags[angry]: Rats, Captain! In MY stores! I'll not cook for a ship that feeds vermin before sailors!

then: mags: Here. Take these down with you. Don't let the rats see you eating them, they'll get ideas.
else: mags[annoyed]: Go on, then. Give them what for.

start: fennimore: Captain. Any new aches, pains, gunshot wounds or existential dread?
heal: fennimore[smug]: There. Good as new, or at least as good as you were. Try not to bleed on my floor.

brask.default: captain: You don't have to shout, Brask.
brask[happy]: SORRY, CAPTAIN! Cotton in the ears! Guns are loud, you know!
brask: Speaking of which, some lubber's gone and moved my spare fuse again! Can't fire a gun without a fuse!
brask: If you see a coil of slow match lying about, it's MINE. Probably down in the hold with the gunnery stores.
brask.fuse_reminder: brask: ANY SIGN OF MY FUSE, CAPTAIN? The hold, I reckon. By the powder.
brask.fuse_return: brask[surprised]: Is that... THAT'S MY FUSE!
brask[laugh]: Knew it'd turn up! Probably walked there by itself. They do that, fuses.
brask: Here, a bit of prize money I'd put by. Buy yourself something LOUD.
brask.after_1: brask: GUNS ARE CLEAN, CAPTAIN! You could eat your dinner off 'em! Don't, though. Powder.
brask.after_2: brask[happy]: Named this one Margaret. That one's Margaret too. Easier to remember!
nell.rounds: nell: South-sou'west, Captain, and she's sailing sweet. The wheel's right here if you want to look over the course.
nell.idle_1: nell: Clear stars last night. We're exactly where I said we'd be. Hale owes me a shilling.
nell.idle_2: nell[smug]: Finch says the gulls flying backwards means a storm. They're flying backwards because they're following the galley scraps.
nell.idle_3: nell: I could use a better chart of these waters, Captain. Ours was drawn by a man who had clearly never been here.
wick.rounds: wick[happy]: I told Mister Hale you were coming! Politely! ...Mostly politely.

then: wick: Can I see the treasure hold, Captain? Just once? I won't touch anything. Much.

wick.rats: wick[concerned]: Rats in the hold? I'm not scared of rats. I'm just going to stay up here, where it's sunny.
wick.idle_1: wick[happy]: Mister Rook says when I'm bigger he'll let me work the capstan all by myself!
wick.idle_2: wick: I've been practising my knots, Captain. This one's a bowline. This one's... a mess.
wick.idle_3: wick[concerned]: Captain, is it true you once took a navy frigate with one pistol and a bad temper?

start: rook: Morning, Cap'n. Fine day for work. Or for a bit of sport.

then: rook[happy]: Stiff as a bishop's collar, Cap'n. I've greased it twice. Next I'll try reasoning with it.

spar: rook[laugh]: Ha! Right. Two volunteers: you, and you. Mind the Captain, lads. He bites.

win: rook[happy]: That's why he's captain, lads. Up you get. Rub some salt in it.
lose: rook[concerned]: Easy, easy! Nobody hits the Captain that hard. Nobody who wants their supper.

sully.idle_1: sully[annoyed]: Swab the deck, says Hale. So I swab the deck. Then it rains and the deck's wet again.
sully: There's a lesson in that, Captain. I just don't care for it.
sully.idle_2: sully: I'm not lazy, Captain. I'm efficient. I do nothing very quickly.
sully.idle_3: sully[happy]: Finch says there's a sea serpent following us. I told him if it wants to swab the deck it's welcome aboard.
sully.rats: sully: Rats in the hold? Can't say I'm surprised, Captain. I've seen the way we eat.
finch.default: finch: Mornin', Captain. The sea's in a mood today. Feel it? Like she's holding her breath.
finch[concerned]: That's what I mean, sir. That's exactly what I mean.

then: finch: You haven't seen an old key about, have you? Rusty thing. Lost it years back. My sea chest's been locked since the Azores.
finch: Rats took it, I'd wager. They take everything shiny. Even when it isn't shiny anymore.

finch.key_return: finch[surprised]: Is that... that's my key! Where'd you find it?
captain: In a rat's nest. With the rat.
finch[happy]: Told you. Rats take everything.
finch: Let me just... there. Forty years of sailing in this chest, Captain. And this.
finch: My fishbone charm. Kept me from drowning since I was a boy. You take it. A captain needs luck more than an old man does.
finch.after: finch[happy]: Feels lighter, having that chest open. Like the sea's let out her breath.
jory.default: jory: Morning, Captain. Found a sprung plank on the larboard side. Nothing serious. She weeps a little, is all. Old ships do.
jory.rats: jory[annoyed]: They've been chewing my patch, Captain. My <y>patch</>. Do you know how long it takes to caulk a seam properly?
jory: The big one's in the far corner, by the bilge pump. Scar across its back. It looked me in the eye. I did not care for it.
jory.after: jory[happy]: Quiet down here now. Just the hull, the drip and me. Thank you, Captain. I'll have this seam done by supper.
